name: Jokei Kazoku
source:
In order to revenge the Sannoji family that forced his brother to commit suicide, main character becomes family adviser to bring forth family's demise.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
为了向逼迫哥哥自杀的三王寺家复仇，主人公成为该家的顾问，企图使整个家族走向毁灭。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
